problem_text:
A logistics manager must select packages to ship on a cargo plane. Available packages are:

* Package 2: size 8 cubic meters, revenue $222

* Package 20: size 43 cubic meters, revenue $69
* Package 21: size 45 cubic meters, revenue $241
* Package 22: size 41 cubic meters, revenue $40
* Package 23: size 18 cubic meters, revenue $88
* Package 24: size 32 cubic meters, revenue $120
* Package 25: size 15 cubic meters, revenue $180
* Package 26: size 6 cubic meters, revenue $64
* Package 27: size 17 cubic meters, revenue $261
* Package 28: size 30 cubic meters, revenue $166

The cargo plane has a maximum capacity of 471 cubic meters. Choose the package combination that maximizes total revenue without exceeding this capacity limit. Each package must be either fully accepted or rejected.
